verdict.rationale: Airweave documents self-hosted local deployment: you clone the repo, run ./start.sh, and get a dashboard at localhost:8080 on macOS, Linux or WSL. That gives a locally run server. However, nothing in the evidence shows an embedded in-process mode, support for local embedding or LLM models, or that the stack runs with zero cloud or API dependencies. Missing for 10: an embedded in-process library mode, documented local-model configuration for embeddings and the search agent, an explicit fully-offline guarantee, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the memory layer fully locally — embedded in-process or against local models — without any cloud dependency

citations.quote: If you prefer to run Airweave yourself, you can deploy it locally on macOS, Linux or WSL.
After cloning the repository and starting the server, you will be able to open the dashboard at http://localhost:8080
